messages.author: 09858b6ac9e567bc
messages.subject: Suspiciously high LOD score
parts:
Hello,
For some of my potential QTLs i am receiving extremely high LOD scores (>200). This calculates into very high percentage of variance explained and that is also very suspicious considering my known-as-noisy experimental setting. For these reasons i suspect it is an artefact but am not sure what causes it. 
I use scanone with method=ehk.
What are some factors that may cause this that I should look into?

Many thanks in advance

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: Suspiciously high LOD score
parts:
Yes, that sounds like there was a problem in the fitting. 

I’d recommend against using method=“ehk”. The method is interesting theoretically but hasn’t proved too useful in practice.
Another method might give you more reasonable results.

karl
